title: Implementing Tensor Logic: Unifying Datalog and Neural Reasoning via Tensor Contraction
benchmark_measurement: The correct computation of ancestor-descendant relationships (transitive closure) in a biblical genealogy graph derived from Christian canonical sources.
findings: The paper found that an iterative tensor-based algorithm could successfully and exactly compute the complete transitive closure of a biblical genealogy graph. The algorithm discovered all 33,945 ancestor relationships from 1,727 direct parent links, converging in 74 iterations, a number that aligns with the approximately 76 generations from Adam to Jesus described in the Gospel of Luke. This demonstrated the mathematical equivalence between recursive Datalog rules and tensor operations using a religious knowledge base.
